records.en_auxiliary: A giant lizard. If it shed its tail to run away from a fight, would that still be called turning tail?
records.en: A giant lizard. If it shed its tail to run away from a fight, would that still be called turning tail?

records.jp: 花のような外観のモンスターね。動きはクラゲのよう。花もクラゲも好きだけれど、残念ながら今回は敵よ
records.en_original: This demon looks like a flower and moves like a jellyfish. I like both of those things, so it's a shame this is an enemy...
records.en_auxiliary: This demon looks like a flower and moves like a jellyfish. I like both of those things, so it's a shame this is an enemy...
records.en: This demon looks like a flower and moves like a jellyfish. I like both of those things, so it's a shame this is an enemy...

records.jp: どういうわけか絶対に倒せない不気味なやつ！　大きなモンスターの取り巻きとして出てきたよ
records.en_original: No matter what we do, this freaky thing won't quit! It's part of a bigger demon's entourage.
records.en_auxiliary: No matter what we do, this freaky thing won't quit! It's part of a bigger demon's entourage.
records.en: No matter what we do, this freaky thing won't quit! It's part of a bigger demon's entourage.

records.jp: 倒せない取り巻きその２。嘆くような動きをしていて、戦っているとなぜだかつらい気持ちになってくる
records.en_original: Stubborn demon #2. It lurches around like it's grieving, and for some reason fighting it causes emotional pain.
records.en_auxiliary: Stubborn demon #2. It lurches around like it's grieving, and for some reason fighting it causes emotional pain.
records.en: Stubborn demon #2. It lurches around like it's grieving, and for some reason fighting it causes emotional pain.

records.jp: 倒せない取り巻きその３。うかつに近づくとなんだか呪われそう！
records.en_original: Stubborn demon #3. Don't be careless—get too close and it'll curse you!
records.en_auxiliary: Stubborn demon #3. Don't be careless—get too close and it'll curse you!
records.en: Stubborn demon #3. Don't be careless—get too close and it'll curse you!

records.jp: 倒せない取り巻きその４。苦しんでいるような動きに見えるのはもしかして消えることができないから……？
records.en_original: Stubborn demon #4. The way it moves makes me think it's suffering. Maybe because it can't pass on?
records.en_auxiliary: Stubborn demon #4. The way it moves makes me think it's suffering. Maybe because it can't pass on?
records.en: Stubborn demon #4. The way it moves makes me think it's suffering. Maybe because it can't pass on?

records.jp: 大きなロボットのようなモンスターだよ。真ん中の一つ目をどうしてもライフルで狙いたくなっちゃう
records.en_original: A giant robot demon. Just looking at it makes me want to aim my rifle right at its eye...
records.en_auxiliary: A giant robot demon. Just looking at it makes me want to aim my rifle right at its eye...
records.en: A giant robot demon. Just looking at it makes me want to aim my rifle right at its eye...

records.jp: ココロトープの途中で行く手を阻んだモンスターです。この時見た星崎さんの流れるような鎌捌きがとても印象に残ってます！
records.en_original: This demon was blocking our path through the Heartscape. Seeing Ao take it down with her scythe so elegantly was impressive!
records.en_auxiliary: This demon was blocking our path through the Heartscape. Seeing Ao take it down with her scythe so elegantly was impressive!
records.en: This demon was blocking our path through the Heartscape. Seeing Hoshizaki-san take it down with her scythe so elegantly was impressive!

records.jp: わたしのココロトープで見かけた頭でっかちなモンス^00ターです。わたしの心の中にいるということは、もしかして、わたしって頭でっかちなんでしょうか……？
records.en_original: A demon with a rather large head, found in my Heartscape. Since it was inside my heart...does that mean I have a big head too?!
records.en_auxiliary: A demon with a rather large head, found in my Heartscape. Since it was inside my heart...does that mean I have a big head too?!
records.en: A demon with a rather large head, found in my Heartscape. Since it was inside my heart...does that mean I have a big head too?!

records.jp: 行く手を阻むように襲ってきたモンスター。ぎょろっとした一つ目に見つめられるとちょっと足がすくむ
records.en_original: A demon that obstructed our path. A single glance from its wandering eye is almost enough to make you freeze in fear.
records.en_auxiliary: A demon that obstructed our path. A single glance from its wandering eye is almost enough to make you freeze in fear.
records.en: A demon that obstructed our path. A single glance from its wandering eye is almost enough to make you freeze in fear.

records.jp: コアを中心に不思議なエネルギーで手足が繋がったモンスター。コアの周りには何らかの力が働いてるのか、なかなか武器が通らなかった
records.en_original: This demon is held together by a strange energy from its core. There's some kind of power around it, and our weapons can't quite cut through...
records.en_auxiliary: This demon is held together by a strange energy from its core. There's some kind of power around it, and our weapons can't quite cut through...
records.en: This demon is held together by a strange energy from its core. There's some kind of power around it, and our weapons can't quite cut through...

records.jp: 腕の鎌が特徴的。きらら的審美眼では、完成されたカマキリのフォルムには及んでいないという評価
records.en_original: This demon has distinctive blades on its arms. But to my aesthetic sensibilities, it doesn't compare to the perfect form of the praying mantis.
records.en_auxiliary: This demon has distinctive blades on its arms. But to my aesthetic sensibilities, it doesn't compare to the perfect form of the praying mantis.
records.en: This demon has distinctive blades on its arms. But to my aesthetic sensibilities, it doesn't compare to the perfect form of the praying mantis.

records.jp: 私のココロトープにあったビル群で戦ったモンスター。凶悪な得物が腕にあって恐ろしかったわ
records.en_original: A demon we fought amongst the buildings in my Heartscape. The fearsome blades on its arms were quite intimidating.
records.en_auxiliary: A demon we fought amongst the buildings in my Heartscape. The fearsome blades on its arms were quite intimidating.
records.en: A demon we fought amongst the buildings in my Heartscape. The fearsome blades on its arms were quite intimidating.

records.jp: 大きな頭を持つ蛇のようなモンスターですね。アンバランスすぎて、押したら倒れそうです
records.en_original: This demon is like a serpent with a large head. It looks so unbalanced that perhaps a single push would topple it.
records.en_auxiliary: This demon is like a serpent with a large head. It looks so unbalanced that perhaps a single push would topple it.
records.en: This demon is like a serpent with a large head. It looks so unbalanced that perhaps a single push would topple it.

records.jp: 巨大な体躯を持つ四つ足のモンスターです。中身はゴム状の物質でできているのか、想像以上にしなやかな動きをしていました
records.en_original: A four-legged demon with an enormous body. It's so flexible that one might think it was made of elastic.
records.en_auxiliary: A four-legged demon with an enormous body. It's so flexible that one might think it was made of elastic.
records.en: A four-legged demon with an enormous body. It's so flexible that one might think it was made of elastic.

records.jp: こういうモンスターは真ん中のクリスタルみたいのが弱点というのが鉄則だよね！
records.en_original: One look at a demon like this and you know its weak point is the crystal in its center. It's, like, the rules!
records.en_auxiliary: One look at a demon like this and you know its weak point is the crystal in its center. It's, like, the rules!
records.en: One look at a demon like this and you know its weak point is the crystal in its center. It's, like, the rules!

records.jp: 空飛ぶ魔人のようなモンスター。同じようなモンスターが複数いて、ユズとライムのココロトープの各ゾーンを守ってるみたい
records.en_original: This demon soars the skies. There are several others like it, each one protecting a Zone in Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: This demon soars the skies. There are several others like it, each one protecting a Zone in Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape.
records.en: This demon soars the skies. There are several others like it, each one protecting a Zone in Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape.

records.jp: ライムさん曰く、悲しみのゾーンを守る化身。私たちも外敵とみなされて攻撃されたらしい
records.en_original: Lime says this form guards the Sorrow Zone. It deemed us enemies and attacked us.
records.en_auxiliary: Lime says this form guards the Sorrow Zone. It deemed us enemies and attacked us.
records.en: Lime-san says this form guards the Sorrow Zone. It deemed us enemies and attacked us.

records.jp: 怒りのゾーンを守る存在なんだって。真っ赤な見た目は確かに怒ってる感じがするね！
records.en_original: This one watches over the Anger Zone. Its red color totally does make it look angry!
records.en_auxiliary: This one watches over the Anger Zone. Its red color totally does make it look angry!
records.en: This one watches over the Anger Zone. Its red color totally does make it look angry!

records.jp: ユズちゃんライムちゃんのココロトープを守る存在の一つだよ。守ってくれてたのに倒しちゃって、少し悲しい気持ち……
records.en_original: One of the beings that guards Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape. I feel bad that we had to fight it even though it was protecting us...
records.en_auxiliary: One of the beings that guards Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape. I feel bad that we had to fight it even though it was protecting us...
records.en: One of the beings that guards Yuzu-chan and Lime-chan's Heartscape. I feel bad that we had to fight it even though it was protecting us...

records.jp: 一対の人型からなるモンスターです。その頭部からは表情はうかがえませんが、どこか悲しみを感じさせます
records.en_original: A demon with the form of a human couple. It has no facial expressions, but somehow it conveys a profound sadness.
records.en_auxiliary: A demon with the form of a human couple. It has no facial expressions, but somehow it conveys a profound sadness.
records.en: A demon with the form of a human couple. It has no facial expressions, but somehow it conveys a profound sadness.

records.jp: “オリジン”の中で道をふさぐように立ってたモンス^00ター。見た目も壁って感じで、まるで通せんぼするために生まれてきたみたい
records.en_original: This demon stood blocking off a path in Origin. It even looks a bit like a wall. It must have been born to be in the way...
records.en_auxiliary: This demon stood blocking off a path in Origin. It even looks a bit like a wall. It must have been born to be in the way...
records.en: This demon stood blocking off a path in Origin. It even looks a bit like a wall. It must have been born to be in the way...

records.jp: “オリジン”の中で遭遇した敵。クラックから入ってきたヤツに似てるよね。アイツもまさかここから……？
records.en_original: This enemy appeared in Origin. It looks like one of the things that came in through the Crack. Wait, are we gonna have to go up against that thing too...?
records.en_auxiliary: This enemy appeared in Origin. It looks like one of the things that came in through the Crack. Wait, are we gonna have to go up against that thing too...?
records.en: This enemy appeared in Origin. It looks like one of the things that came in through the Crack. Wait, are we gonna have to go up against that thing too...?

records.jp: わたしのココロトープの一番奥にいたモンスターだよ。わたしたちの邪魔をしているように見えたけど、見方を変えればフラグメントを守ってくれていたのかも
records.en_original: The demon from the deepest part of my Heartscape. It looked like it was standing in the way, but you could also say it was protecting my Fragment...
records.en_auxiliary: The demon from the deepest part of my Heartscape. It looked like it was standing in the way, but you could also say it was protecting my Fragment...
records.en: The demon from the deepest part of my Heartscape. It looked like it was standing in the way, but you could also say it was protecting my Fragment...

records.jp: わたしのフラグメントの前に降り立ったモンスターです。空から舞い降りてきて、どこか神々しさがありましたね
records.en_original: This demon stood before my Fragment. There was something divine about the way it swooped down out of the sky.
records.en_auxiliary: This demon stood before my Fragment. There was something divine about the way it swooped down out of the sky.
records.en: This demon stood before my Fragment. There was something divine about the way it swooped down out of the sky.

records.jp: 私のココロトープの学校前にいたモンスター。こんなに頭があって、首は絡まらないのかな？
records.en_original: The demon that stood in front of the school in my Heartscape. With all of those heads, do its necks ever get tangled up?
records.en_auxiliary: The demon that stood in front of the school in my Heartscape. With all of those heads, do its necks ever get tangled up?
records.en: The demon that stood in front of the school in my Heartscape. With all of those heads, do its necks ever get tangled up?

records.jp: クラックから現れた謎の存在。あんなのが、この世界の外にはうようよいるのかな？
records.en_original: A strange creature that emerged from a Crack. Is the outside world swarming with things like this?
records.en_auxiliary: A strange creature that emerged from a Crack. Is the outside world swarming with things like this?
records.en: A strange creature that emerged from a Crack. Is the outside world swarming with things like this?

records.jp: 私のフラグメントの前に立ちはだかったモンスター。ドリルの両手なんて有り？　貫かれたらホントにまずかった
records.en_original: The demon that stood in the way of my Fragment. What kind of creature has drills for hands? We'd have been done for if it had pierced us...
records.en_auxiliary: The demon that stood in the way of my Fragment. What kind of creature has drills for hands? We'd have been done for if it had pierced us...
records.en: The demon that stood in the way of my Fragment. What kind of creature has drills for hands? We'd have been done for if it had pierced us...

records.jp: きららのフラグメントの前にいたモンスター。ドラゴンみたいでカッコイイ
records.en_original: The demon that stood before my Fragment. It looks like a dragon. So cool.
records.en_auxiliary: The demon that stood before my Fragment. It looks like a dragon. So cool.
records.en: The demon that stood before my Fragment. It looks like a dragon. So cool.

records.jp: 私たちのココロトープの一番奥にいたモンスターだよ！あんなでっかい剣、よく振り回せるなあ。私なら体の方が振り回されちゃうよ
records.en_original: One of the demons at the end of our Heartscape! I don't know how it can swing that huge sword around. I think the sword would be the one swinging me!
records.en_auxiliary: One of the demons at the end of our Heartscape! I don't know how it can swing that huge sword around. I think the sword would be the one swinging me!
records.en: One of the demons at the end of our Heartscape! I don't know how it can swing that huge sword around. I think the sword would be the one swinging me!

records.jp: 私たちのココロトープの一番奥にいたもう一体のモンスターね。二体の猛攻にみんな難儀したみたい。私たちのために、戦ってくれてみんなには感謝しきれないわ
records.en_original: The other demon at the end of Hiori's and my Heartscape. It seems that they both put up a bitter fight. I truly appreciate everyone fighting for us.
records.en_auxiliary: The other demon at the end of Hiori's and my Heartscape. It seems that they both put up a bitter fight. I truly appreciate everyone fighting for us.
records.en: The other demon at the end of Hiori's and my Heartscape. It seems that they both put up a bitter fight. I truly appreciate everyone fighting for us.

records.jp: クラックから侵入してきた存在。世界システムが生み出したのか、迫りくる「無」が形になったものなのかはわからないけど、この世界を守るために、こんなのに負けるわけにはいかない……！
records.en_original: A creature that emerged from a Crack. I don't know if it's from the World System or if it's a form of the nothingness to come, but we have to defeat it to protect this world!
records.en_auxiliary: A creature that emerged from a Crack. I don't know if it's from the World System or if it's a form of the nothingness to come, but we have to defeat it to protect this world!
records.en: A creature that emerged from a Crack. I don't know if it's from the World System or if it's a form of the nothingness to come, but we have to defeat it to protect this world!

records.jp: あたしのフラグメントを守っていたモンスターだよ。^00きっと本当のあたしを隠そうとしてたんだ
records.en_original: The demon that guarded my Fragment. I'm sure that it was trying to hide the real me.
records.en_auxiliary: The demon that guarded my Fragment. I'm sure that it was trying to hide the real me.
records.en: The demon that guarded my Fragment. I'm sure that it was trying to hide the real me.

records.jp: 雫世界の管理区域を守っていたモンスター。生みの親でさえ敵と認識されるなんて難儀だなあ
records.en_original: This demon guarded the Oasis Access Control Area. It's so troublesome that even its own mother would see it as an enemy.
records.en_auxiliary: This demon guarded the Oasis Access Control Area. It's so troublesome that even its own mother would see it as an enemy.
records.en: This demon guarded the Oasis Access Control Area. It's so troublesome that even its own mother would see it as an enemy.

records.jp: 私のフラグメントの前にいたモンスターです。まるでサソリのようなフォルム……過去の私という“毒”を持つ身にはふさわしいのかもしれません
records.en_original: The demon that stood before my Fragment. It looks just like a scorpion...which I suppose is appropriate as it bears the "poison" of my past self.
records.en_auxiliary: The demon that stood before my Fragment. It looks just like a scorpion...which I suppose is appropriate as it bears the "poison" of my past self.
records.en: The demon that stood before my Fragment. It looks just like a scorpion...which I suppose is appropriate as it bears the "poison" of my past self.

records.jp: 赤い水に沈んだ学校……あれはきっと、私たちの想いと世界システムがぶつかり合ってできた場所だ。だから、私たちが戦っていたのは、きっと“システム”自身なんだ
records.en_original: The school, plunged into a sea of red. It must have been born from our emotions colliding with the World System—so what we've been fighting is the System itself.
records.en_auxiliary: The school, plunged into a sea of red. It must have been born from our emotions colliding with the World System—so what we've been fighting is the System itself.
records.en: The school, plunged into a sea of red. It must have been born from our emotions colliding with the World System—so what we've been fighting is the System itself.

records.jp: “システム”が周囲のものを取り込んで力を増した姿。力でねじ伏せてすべてを終わらせようなんて、そうはさせない！
records.en_original: The System's form upon absorbing the power from everything around it. It's trying to annihilate all existence, but we're not going to let that happen!
records.en_auxiliary: The System's form upon absorbing the power from everything around it. It's trying to annihilate all existence, but we're not going to let that happen!
records.en: The System's form upon absorbing the power from everything around it. It's trying to annihilate all existence, but we're not going to let that happen!

records.jp: 周囲のエネルギーを取り込み、さらに力を解放した“システム”の姿。きっと相手が終わらせようとしているのは、私たちの想いだ。大丈夫。私たちの想いは負けない！
records.en_original: The System's form after absorbing all surrounding energy and unleashing even more power. It wants to eradicate all our emotions, but we will not lose!
records.en_auxiliary: The System's form after absorbing all surrounding energy and unleashing even more power. It wants to eradicate all our emotions, but we will not lose!
records.en: The System's form after absorbing all surrounding energy and unleashing even more power. It wants to eradicate all our emotions, but we will not lose!

records.jp: 私たちは想いを未来へ結ぶ。たとえ“せかい”が敵になろうとも
records.en_original: These emotions that course through us—we will find a way to tie them to the future, even if it means fighting the world!
records.en_auxiliary: These emotions that course through us—we will find a way to tie them to the future, even if it means fighting the world!
records.en: These emotions that course through us—we will find a way to tie them to the future, even if it means fighting the world!

records.jp: 隠れ島で会った影の一人。元の世界に戻るためには、いろんなことを我慢しなきゃいけない……そんな想いが一つの影になったみたい。大切な想いの一つだ。他の影とも仲良くやっていけるといいな
records.en_original: One of the shadows on the Hidden Island. It comes from our feelings of having to restrain ourselves from so much to get back to our world. I guess even this emotion is important too...
records.en_auxiliary: One of the shadows on the Hidden Island. It comes from our feelings of having to restrain ourselves from so much to get back to our world. I guess even this emotion is important too...
records.en: One of the shadows on the Hidden Island. It comes from our feelings of having to restrain ourselves from so much to get back to our world. I guess even this emotion is important too...

records.jp: 強い欲望が形になった影。すべての欲望が叶ったら、それは嬉しいと思う……けど、本当に叶えたい大切なものだけは見失わないようにしないとね
records.en_original: A shadow made from feelings of greed. Sure, it'd be nice if all our dreams came true, but we have to keep our eye on what's really important.
records.en_auxiliary: A shadow made from feelings of greed. Sure, it'd be nice if all our dreams came true, but we have to keep our eye on what's really important.
records.en: A shadow made from feelings of greed. Sure, it'd be nice if all our dreams came true, but we have to keep our eye on what's really important.

records.jp: ありのままの自分を認めてほしい、そんな想いが現れた影だと思う。我慢するのってとても辛い。お腹がすいたら、誰だって美味しいご飯を食べたいよね
records.en_original: I think this shadow comes from our desire to be accepted for who we are. Resisting that desire is agonizing—like resisting something tasty when you’re hungry.
records.en_auxiliary: I think this shadow comes from our desire to be accepted for who we are. Resisting that desire is agonizing—like resisting something tasty when you’re hungry.
records.en: I think this shadow comes from our desire to be accepted for who we are. Resisting that desire is agonizing—like resisting something tasty when you’re hungry.

records.jp: ダルい、ダルいとしきりに言っている影。私の形をしているのは……普段しっかり者のように振舞って心の奥底に閉じ込めている分、怠けたい思いが強くなっているのかもね
records.en_original: This shadow complains about everything. And it looks like me... Maybe by trying to look like I've got it all together, I'm repressing my desire to slack off—making that feeling all the stronger.
records.en_auxiliary: This shadow complains about everything. And it looks like me... Maybe by trying to look like I've got it all together, I'm repressing my desire to slack off—making that feeling all the stronger.
records.en: This shadow complains about everything. And it looks like me... Maybe by trying to look like I've got it all together, I'm repressing my desire to slack off—making that feeling all the stronger.

records.jp: 遊びたいという想いが形になった影だよ。確かに楽しいことが大好きだけど、こうして見せられるとなんだかちょっと恥ずかしいなぁ
records.en_original: This shadow comes from the feeling of wanting to play. I mean, yeah, I do like to have fun, but seeing it like this made me feel a little ashamed of myself.
records.en_auxiliary: This shadow comes from the feeling of wanting to play. I mean, yeah, I do like to have fun, but seeing it like this made me feel a little ashamed of myself.
records.en: This shadow comes from the feeling of wanting to play. I mean, yeah, I do like to have fun, but seeing it like this made me feel a little ashamed of myself.

records.jp: 自由を求める想いが形になった影のようです。わたしたちの自由を尊重してくれるので、話し合いにも参加してくれました。いろんなしがらみから解き放たれたら……そんな憧れは確かにあるかもしれません
records.en_original: A shadow made from the desire for freedom. It respects our freedom too, and even took part in our discussions. Being free of all duties and obligations... I suppose that does sound nice.
records.en_auxiliary: A shadow made from the desire for freedom. It respects our freedom too, and even took part in our discussions. Being free of all duties and obligations... I suppose that does sound nice.
records.en: A shadow made from the desire for freedom. It respects our freedom too, and even took part in our discussions. Being free of all duties and obligations... I suppose that does sound nice.

records.jp: ライザさんのココロトープの最奥にいたモンスター。他の場所では見かけたことのない風貌をしてるし、ライザさんの記憶に強く残ってる存在なのかもしれない
records.en_original: A demon that appeared in the depths of Ryza's Heartscape. It looks different from anything we've seen before, so it must be something from Ryza's memories that left a lasting impact on her.
records.en: A demon that appeared in the depths of Ryza-san's Heartscape. It looks different from anything we've seen before, so it must be something from Ryza-san's memories that left a lasting impact on her.

records.jp: ライザさんのココロトープに現れた人型のモンスター。椅子に座って偉そうにしてるけど、その見た目に違わぬ強さを持ってるよ。それにしても、あの浮いてる椅子便利そう。私も欲しい
records.en_original: A humanoid demon that appeared in Ryza's Heartscape. It looks all high and mighty sitting in its throne, and it's just as powerful as it looks. Having a floating chair like that would be great, though. I wish I had one...
records.en: A humanoid demon that appeared in Ryza-san's Heartscape. It looks all high and mighty sitting in its throne, and it's just as powerful as it looks. Having a floating chair like that would be great, though. I wish I had one...

records.jp: ライザさんのココロトープ最奥にいたモンスター。ぷにぷにだけど、結構強い。他の場所では見かけたことがないし、ライザさんの世界にいるモンスターなのかも
records.en_original: A demon that lurked in the farthest depths of Ryza's Heartscape. Even though it's squishy, it's quite strong. I haven't seen one like it anywhere else, so maybe it's a demon from Ryza's world.
